scheme_name: Grant Scheme for Marriage of Daughters of Destitute Widow
other_conditions: Applicant must be sanctioned for widow pension from the district probation office
Bride (daughter) must be between 18 and 45 years of age
Groom must be between 21 and 45 years of age
Applicant may belong to BPL category if monthly family income exceeds ₹4,000
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 to eligible beneficiaries.
